messages:
ryan: Noticed a brief spike in cross-region retries (eu->us) at 02:14 UTC. TLS handshake failures + short TTL flips in DNS logs. Looks related to a small host churn.

anya: Can you paste the trace?

ryan: Trace: client->edge-eu-hostpool -> gateway-us shows `alert: handshake_failure(40)` then 502s on proxy. DNS queries show TTLs returning 1s then back to normal.

mike: Ops bot shows a control-plane host replace at 02:12. Could be a provisioning race that broke cert symlinks again.

ops-bot: Incident auto-ticket created: INC-2028-0099. Attached events: host-replace, dns-ttl-flip.

sara: I'll take ownership of immediate mitigations. Plan: 1) add proxy-side exponential backoff for eu routes, 2) run a short canary excluding suspicious hosts, 3) open infra PR for atomic cert swap. Due: EOD for canary.

anya: For backoff use: `retry: {strategy: exp, base_ms: 250, max_ms: 4000, attempts: 4}`. Minimal change.

ryan: Running canary exclude now. Canary ID cny-208500-01.

sara: Filing follow-up ticket PM-INC-2209-CERT-DRIFT with owners: sara (mitigation), mike (infra PR), anya (dns audit).

mike: Found a repro: when provisioner writes certs concurrently with kubelet restart the `/etc/ssl/current` symlink can point to stale dir. PR ready: https://git/redwood/infra/pull/1903 (atomic swap + systemd ordering).

ops-bot: Canary cny-208500-01 started. Monitoring window 6m.

anya: DNS audit: control-plane pushed hostpool resize at 02:10 right before churn. Cause likely planned scale event overlapping with repro window. Adding guard to avoid concurrent provision during scale for 48h.

ryan: Canary metrics: retries down ~70%, TLS alerts back to baseline. Link: https://dashboards/redwood/canary/cny-208500-01

sara: Good signal. Next: promote backoff config to staged rollout and merge infra PR after review. I'll add recurring monitor: RMON-2209-TLS with owner mike, alert if region spike > threshold 3x in 7d.

mike: Will shepherd PR and add unit test. Expect merge in 24h.

ryan: Thanks all. Quick check in 3h to verify rollouts. :thumbsup:
